title: Lateral packing of imbricated blades governs species-dependent bacterial suppression on ball python scales: model and analysis code
description: Version 2.0.0 of the blade-array model and reproducibility package associated with the manuscript 'Lateral packing of imbricated blades governs species-dependent bacterial suppression on ball python scales'. The archive includes the active model implementation, analysis scripts, simulation-level CSV outputs, derived statistical tables, manuscript figures, LaTeX source, supplementary-material source and compiled submission PDFs. The geometric and mechanistic sensitivity analyses, numerical verification and external Sharklet comparison are included.
